title: Smartphone Multi-modal Biometric Authentication: Database and Evaluation
reasoning: The paper is a technical work focused on creating and evaluating a multi-modal biometric dataset for smartphone authentication. It details the data collection process, the dataset's characteristics, the presentation attack dataset, and the performance of baseline verification and anti-spoofing algorithms. The paper does not engage with topics of religion, faith, spirituality, morals, or ethics as a primary research or evaluation component.
